question: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your email address and we'll send you a reset link. The link expires in 24 hours. If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder or contact support.

question: How do I update my billing information?
answer: You can update your billing information by going to Account Settings > Billing. From there, you can add or remove credit cards, update your billing address, and view past invoices. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and PayPal. For annual plans, we also accept bank transfers and wire payments. All payments are processed securely through our PCI-compliant payment provider.

question: What is your shipping policy?
answer: We offer free standard shipping on orders over $50. Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days, expedited shipping takes 2-3 business days ($9.99), and overnight shipping is available for $19.99. We ship to all 50 US states and select international destinations.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. To start a return, go to your Order History, select the order, and click 'Return Item'. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label via email. Items must be in original condition with tags attached.

question: How long does a refund take to process?
answer: Once we receive your returned item, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days. The refund will be credited to your original payment method. Credit card refunds may take an additional 5-10 business days to appear on your statement depending on your bank.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: To delete your account, go to Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. You'll be asked to confirm your password. Please note that account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. All your data, order history, and saved preferences will be removed within 30 days.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: You can track your order by going to Order History in your account and clicking on the order number. You'll see real-time tracking information including the current status and estimated delivery date. You'll also receive email updates when your order ships and is delivered.

question: How do I cancel or change my subscription?
answer: To manage your subscription, go to Account Settings > Subscription. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time. If you cancel, your subscription remains active until the end of your current billing period. No partial refunds are given for mid-cycle cancellations.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our customer support team via live chat on our website (available 24/7), by email at support@example.com (response within 24 hours), or by phone at 1-800-555-0123 (Monday to Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM EST). For urgent issues, live chat is the fastest option.

question: What are the system requirements for your product?
answer: Our web application works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend using the latest browser version for the best experience. Our mobile apps require iOS 15+ or Android 12+. A stable internet connection is required for all features.

question: Do you offer a free trial?
answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial on all plans. No credit card is required to start your trial. You'll get full access to all features during the trial period. At the end of the trial, you can choose a paid plan or your account will be downgraded to the free tier.

question: How do I change my email address?
answer: To change your email address, go to Account Settings > Profile and click 'Edit' next to your email. You'll need to verify the new email address by clicking a confirmation link we send. Your old email will remain active until the new one is verified.

question: Is my data secure?
answer: Yes, we take security seriously. All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption. We are SOC 2 Type II compliant, conduct regular security audits, and offer two-factor authentication for all accounts. We never sell your personal data to third parties.

question: Can I get an invoice for my purchase?
answer: Yes, invoices are automatically generated for every payment. You can find them in Account Settings > Billing > Invoice History. Each invoice is available as a downloadable PDF. If you need a custom invoice with specific details like a PO number or tax ID, contact our billing support team.
